headline: Claude Maps the Bug Bounty Hunt
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized security research into a repeatable field procedure. Its 83 skills, vulnerability patterns, reconnaissance flows, and evidence templates give red teams a structured route from scope checks to defensible reports.

headline: Cursor Opens Its Plugin Workshop
lede: Cursor/plugins treats agent capability as a modular engineering surface. Each plugin packages skills, workflows, and service integrations so coding teams—and adjacent business functions—can assemble repeatable operations without rebuilding every connector.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Agents a Handle
lede: CLI-Anything builds the missing command surface between autonomous agents and complex desktop software. Standardized, tested harnesses let agents operate tools such as Blender, Kdenlive, Obsidian, and Zotero through predictable commands rather than fragile improvisation.

headline: Last30days Turns Web Noise Into Briefings
lede: Last30days-skill pulls recent signals from social platforms, news, markets, research, and developer communities into one evidence-grounded report. Parallel searches and source-specific engagement signals help the agent connect scattered observations without flattening their provenance.

headline: Arcane Brings Docker Into View
lede: Arcane puts Docker administration behind a focused web interface for containers, images, volumes, networks, and Compose stacks. It preserves direct control of self-hosted infrastructure while making routine inspection and deployment easier to share across a team.

headline: SkillEvaluator Draws the Agent Quality Gate
lede: NVIDIA’s SkillEvaluator lays out a staged route from static inspection to live behavioral testing. Teams can validate schemas, licensing, secrets, dependencies, duplication, harness compatibility, and task performance before a skill reaches production or a merge queue.

headline: nvm Keeps 96,109 Stars in Motion
lede: nvm remains the practical switchboard for Node.js versions across shells, projects, CI, and WSL. Per-user installs, aliases, and .nvmrc files let developers test incompatible runtimes without disturbing the system installation.

headline: uv Rebuilds Python Tooling for Speed
lede: Written in Rust, uv consolidates Python installation, dependency resolution, environments, publishing, and project workflows into one fast toolchain. Its content-addressed cache, universal lockfiles, and PubGrub resolver target reproducibility without surrendering performance.

headline: PaperOrchestra Conducts a Paper Pipeline
lede: PaperOrchestra organizes the passage from experimental notes to a submission-ready LaTeX manuscript. Specialized agents handle outlines, literature review, drafting, reflection, and figures, while configurable models and conference templates keep the scholarly workflow extensible.

headline: Stitch Skills Turns Screens Into Systems
lede: Stitch Design Skills connects visual prototyping to production through a catalog of agent workflows. Designs can become React, React Native, Vite, shadcn/ui, or Remotion outputs, while theme, asset, and design-system skills keep the handoff coherent.
